items.title: 31.7 Energy density aur specific energy (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of energy density and specific energy (PDF 228); the energy chart is our own drawing.

blocks.text: Kisi kaam ke liye fuel chunte waqt do ahem cheezein dekhi jati hain: energy density aur specific energy.

blocks.title: Energy density
blocks.text: Energy density kisi substance mein energy rakhne ki salahiyat (capacity) hai. Ise aam taur par fuel ke har unit volume (hajm) mein jama ho sakne wali energy se bataya jata hai, aksar megajoules per liter (MJ/L) mein.

Zyada energy density wale fuels thore volume mein bohat energy rakh lete hain. Yeh aik jagah khare kaamon (stationary applications) aur storage ke liye faidemand hain, maslan power plants aur generators. Maslan diesel ki energy density (~35.8 MJ/L) gasoline (~34.2 MJ/L) se zyada hai, yani diesel ke har liter mein zyada energy hai.

blocks.title: Specific energy
blocks.text: Specific energy kisi mass (kamiyat) mein mojood energy ki miqdar hai. Ise aam taur par megajoules per kilogram (MJ/kg) mein napte hain.

Yeh wahan ahem hai jahan wazan (weight) bohat ahmiyat rakhta hai, jaise hawai jahaz (aviation) ya spacecraft. Zyada specific energy wala fuel zyada wazan barhaye baghair bohat energy deta hai. Maslan hydrogen gas ki specific energy bohat zyada (120 MJ/kg) hai, is liye yeh aerospace ke liye dilchasp hai, halanke is ki energy density kam hai.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Pakistan mein gariyon mein use hone wali Compressed Natural Gas (CNG) bohat sasti (economical) hai. Lekin is ki energy density petrol se kam hai, yani utni energy ke liye gari ko zyada volume ka cylinder uthana parta hai. Isi liye CNG shehar ke andar chhote safar ke liye theek hai, lambe safar ke liye behtar nahi.

blocks.alt: Baen: MJ per litre ka bar chart, diesel 35.8 aur gasoline 34.2. Daen: chhota petrol tank aur bara CNG cylinder, neeche 'same energy, more volume'.
blocks.caption: Energy density: diesel aur gasoline, petrol tank aur CNG cylinder (asal khaaka; kitab ki figure nahi).

blocks.prompt: 50 L diesel ke tank mein, aur 50 L gasoline mein, taqreeban kitni energy hai?
blocks.explanation: Diesel: 50 × 35.8 = taqreeban 1790 MJ; gasoline: 50 × 34.2 = taqreeban 1710 MJ.

blocks.prompt: Spacecraft ke liye zyada energy density wala fuel dekhenge ya zyada specific energy wala? Kyun?
blocks.explanation: Zyada specific energy wala, kyunke yahan wazan sab se ahem hai: fuel zyada wazan barhaye baghair bohat energy de.

items: Energy density: har unit volume mein energy (MJ/L); diesel ~35.8 > gasoline ~34.2.
Specific energy: har unit mass mein energy (MJ/kg); hydrogen 120 MJ/kg.
CNG: sasti lekin kam energy density; shehar ke andar safar ke liye munasib.
